name: Network for Good
description: Bonterra Network for Good is fundraising and donor-management software for small and midsize nonprofits. Organizations use it to manage supporters, gifts, pledges, households and volunteers, build fundraising pages, run events and auctions, send email and SMS, report on results, and receive fundraising guidance.
agentUseSummary: Network for Good cannot currently be connected to Relay agents because Bonterra publishes no supported customer account API, delegated OAuth contract, API-key contract, remote MCP service, or distributable partner interface for this product.

blocked.label: Connect a Network for Good account
blocked.description: Bonterra does not publish a supported OAuth, API-key, remote MCP, or partner connection contract for Network for Good customer accounts.

blocked.label: Use Network for Good account data
blocked.description: Bonterra does not document public authentication, endpoints, schemas, permissions, rate limits, webhooks or developer terms for programmatic access to Network for Good donor and fundraising records.

blocked.label: Automate the private Network for Good application
blocked.description: Relay does not collect Network for Good passwords, impersonate access holders, automate its private browser application or reverse engineer undocumented endpoints containing donor and payment data.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent action can be enabled until Bonterra publishes or grants Relay a supported distributable Network for Good account interface.

runtimeSupport.description: No documented public Network for Good account API or remote MCP service is available to mount as OpenClaw tools.
No documented public Network for Good account API or remote MCP service is available to mount as Hermes tools.

providerSetup.blocker: Bonterra's current Network for Good product, help, training, pricing and services materials expose customer UI workflows, exports and selected product-managed integrations but no public or approved distributable customer account API contract for Relay.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not request credentials or show Connect. Reconsider Network for Good only if Bonterra publishes a supported customer account API or grants Relay a distributable partner agreement with documented authentication, endpoints, schemas, permissions, limits, lifecycle and donor-data terms.

evidence.supports: Bonterra describes Network for Good as an all-in-one donor-management, fundraising, communications, events, auctions and coaching product for small nonprofits; the product page offers demos and UI features but no developer or account API surface.

Bonterra's current comparison lists Network for Good customer features and separately advertises EveryAction's robust API for custom integrations, without claiming equivalent Network for Good API access.

The current Network for Good help center documents customer administration, donor management, importing/exporting, fundraising, events, auctions and communications but exposes no public developer authentication or callable account API contract.
Bonterra documents QuickBooks Online as a product-managed transaction sync configured inside Network for Good, not a general customer-authorized API that Relay may mount.

Bonterra confirms it acquired Network for Good's nonprofit software business while the separate donor-advised fund continues independently, preventing Relay from conflating the software product with the For Good DAF.
